officialEvidence.operatorDescription: IP Innovative Power GmbH operates Energy-as-a-Service microgrids including EV charging infrastructure in Germany and other European markets.

pricingEvidence.notes: Public station directories confirm ad-hoc/web/app access at multiple IP Innovative Power sites but do not expose a verified direct price. Kia Charge Business publishes eMSP roaming prices for DEIPG; those are not CPO-direct prices and are discovery-only. App-store user comments are not authoritative tariff evidence and are not promoted.

policy: Resolve DE*IPG to IP Innovative Power GmbH where canonical operator identity matches. Do not attach roaming/eMSP prices to the physical CPO. Keep direct ad-hoc tariff fail-closed until a primary checkout, QR/web endpoint, AFIR/Mobilithek price field or other station-level public source provides the exact current price.
